subtitle.zh: 20天，做出能解释路由、容量与故障的工程作品
subtitle.en: 20 days to a portfolio explaining routing, capacity and failures

description.zh: 以llm-d v1.0.0为资料基线，贯通Kubernetes端点发现、缓存感知路由、P/D分离、SLO、准入、升级和故障恢复。20个逐日CPU实验、20张图解、3种交互模型与40道解析题，先在普通电脑完成可复查作品，再制定真实集群验证。
description.en: Use llm-d v1.0.0 as the source baseline to connect Kubernetes discovery, cache-aware routing, P/D separation, SLOs, admission, upgrades and recovery. Twenty daily CPU exercises, twenty diagrams, three interactive models and forty explained questions build a reviewable laptop portfolio before real-cluster validation.

prerequisites.en: Complete foundations, vLLM and Kubernetes first. Read Python lists/dicts and understand Pods, Services, HTTP and prefill/decode. You can run models earlier, but complete prerequisites before the design tasks.

hardware.zh: 必做：普通电脑、Python 3.9+标准库，无GPU、账户、网络或模型下载。可选真实部署：符合固定版本官方指南的Kubernetes集群、模型存储与CPU/加速器资源；本课未运行真实llm-d。
hardware.en: Required: a laptop and Python 3.9+ standard library; no GPU, account, network or model download. Optional deployment needs a Kubernetes cluster, model storage and CPU/accelerator resources compatible with the pinned guide. Real llm-d was not executed here.

Establish a correct single-engine baseline before changing one routing or TTL variable and predefine rollback triggers.
